**Finding: Compliant — no redline needed.**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant of any kind (no hits for "solicit", "induce", or "recruit" as a restriction; §§ 12, 16 and 30 are clear). Section 12.3 goes further in our favour, expressly preserving Northwind's right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and recording that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

That is our preferred playbook position (no non-solicit on Customer), so the fallback (mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to service personnel with advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) is only relevant if Brightline later asks to add one.
